description: This is a Java test source file for the EventSenderImpl class, containing unit tests that verify behavior such as message sending, handling of delivery outcomes, credit checking, and message durability within the org.eclipse.hono.client.impl package.

classes.name: EventSenderImplTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class employing VertxUnitRunner to verify the behaviors of the EventSenderImpl class, including message transmission, acknowledgment handling, and message properties.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSendMessageWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Tests that the sender waits for a message to be accepted before completing successfully.

methods.name: testSendMessageFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Tests that the sender fails if the message is rejected by the peer.

methods.name: testSendAndWaitForOutcomeFailsOnLackOfCredit
methods.description: Verifies that message sending fails if there is no available credit.

methods.name: testSendMarksMessageAsDurable
methods.description: Ensures that messages sent are marked as durable.

methods.name: testSendAndWaitForOutcomeMarksMessageAsDurable
methods.description: Ensures that messages sent with wait-for-outcome also are marked as durable.
